headlines.title: Election results yield historic firsts
headlines.description: From state capitals to the halls of Congress, the elections resulted in a sea of fresh faces and a wave of firsts in political leadership across the country. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports on the history making changes.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass in the L.A. mayor’s race
headlines.description: City Council member Nithya Raman has defeated incumbent Karen Bass in the Los Angeles mayoral race, NBC News projects, capping off a rapid political ascent for a progressive challenger who railed against the “broken status quo” in the country’s second-largest metropolis.

headlines.title: Stocks plunge as AI worries crush tech shares
headlines.description: Shares in technology companies plunged, compounding declines and sparking concerns about the durability of artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Wave of Bomb Threats Target Flights All Across Europe
headlines.description: Flights across Europe have been targeted in a wave of alarming bomb threats. There have been no casualties, and no explosives have so far been found, but officials are taking precautions with bomb squads deployed in airports across the continent. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Tech moguls suffer defeat as midterm results show young men swinging away from Trump
headlines.description: Young men, a key voting block that helped President Trump return to the White House in 2024, are now swinging away from him even after tech billionaires spent a record amount on midterms. The results show critical cracks in the so-called "manosphere." NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: LIV Golf plans to shut down
headlines.description: LIV Golf, the breakaway golf tour backed by Saudi royalty and some of the biggest names in the game, said Thursday it planned to wind down — a stunning conclusion to an effort that had received billions of dollars in backing.

headlines.title: Melania Trump on Oleshky ceasefire: Russia and Ukraine have chosen 'humanity over war'
headlines.description: First lady Melania Trump hosted delegations from Russia and Ukraine to highlight the humanitarian ceasefire she helped broker in Oleshky. She praised the countries for choosing "humanity over war" by following through with the agreement.

headlines.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
headlines.description: British comedian and actor Russell Brand was found guilty/not guilty of several charges of rape and sexual assault by a London court.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Affording America: The rising costs of family farming
headlines.description: Javier Zamora achieved his dream of starting his own family farm and watching his customer base grow, but as the costs of labor, chemicals, and diesel have risen, his profit margins have continued to fall.

headlines.title: The Met’s Costume Institute pivots after scrapping controversial Galliano show
headlines.description: A new theme for next year’s Met Gala exhibit was announced Thursday, two months after event organizers scrapped their original idea to honor British designer John Galliano following backlash over his past anti-Jewish and anti-Asian remarks.
